in_sanskrit.name: उज्जयन्त्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is victorious, conquering, or triumphant

in_marathi.name: Ujjayant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ujjayant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ujjayant means 'conquering' or 'victorious' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the root words 'ud' (up, superior) and 'jay' (victory).

in_bengali.name: Ujjayant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ujjayant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ujjayant means 'conquering' or 'victorious' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the root words 'ud' (up, superior) and 'jay' (victory).
